summary: Iter-26 /login + /signup UI/UX refresh — full Playwright E2E. Verified AuthShell renders friendly multi-color benefit tiles, plain-English copy, password show/hide toggle, signup strength meter (Too short→Weak→Okay→Strong), ?ref= prefill + applied badge, footer cross-links, error toasts (empty/short pw, wrong creds), successful new-user signup → /me, mobile responsiveness (0 overflow, form-above-tiles order), and absence of all forbidden old hacker strings (ACCESS_TERMINAL/CREATE_OPERATOR/AUTHENTICATE/operator@domain.com/CREATE_ACCOUNT). All 12 review requirements pass.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthShell.jsx uses inline `<style>` block per render — acceptable but could be moved to a CSS module/global stylesheet to avoid re-injection on each mount.
Signup useEffect dependency on `refFromUrl` overwrites any user-typed value if they share/edit URL — minor UX edge case but matches spec (URL is source of truth).
Login `useEffect` redirect uses `loc.state?.from` — if `from` points to a protected route, OK; consider also clearing `nav` history entry so back button doesn't return to /login.
Both pages: input `type='email'` does built-in browser validation; combined with custom toast it can fire HTML5 popover AND toast for the same error — works but redundant.
scorePw thresholds give 'Okay' at length≥10 alphabetic-only — a 20-char all-letters pw never reaches 'Strong'. Maybe acceptable for friendliness, but consider awarding length-bonus.
test_credentials: Created e2e_test_<timestamp>@example.com / Test1234! during run; seed user test1@example.com / hack123 also documented.
seed_data_creation: One new test user (e2e_test_<ts>@example.com) was registered to exercise the signup → /me redirect flow. No cleanup performed (no DELETE endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-26 ships only /login + /signup redesign via shared AuthShell. All new data-testids work (auth-title, auth-benefits, login-toggle-pw, login-link-signup, signup-toggle-pw, signup-pw-strength, signup-ref-applied, signup-link-login). Backend auth endpoints unchanged. Note: GET /api/auth/logout returns 405 (POST-only) — when scripting logout in tests, use POST or page.evaluate fetch with method:POST.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Two transient script failures during first run were diagnosed and re-verified in a fresh browser context: (1) 'auth-title=Welcome back' on /signup was an SPA navigation race — re-reading after fresh load returned correct "Let's get you started". (2) Wrong-pw URL check was confounded by an earlier session not being logged out (GET /api/auth/logout 405); re-test in clean context confirmed toast 'Invalid email or password' shows and URL remains /login. Placeholder 'you@email.com' is present in rendered HTML (verified via page.content()) but not in textContent — test was using textContent which excludes input attributes; not a bug.
